plans.idea: Classic left-to-right banner read: logo, then a wide two-line headline, then the warm image tile paired with the phone product, ending on a strong CTA at the right edge, all centred on one horizontal axis.

Imagery leads at the left (warm tile plus phone, echoing the original's image panel), the headline gets the widest possible centre band for maximum size, and brand plus action stack together in a tidy right-hand column.

Brand-then-product opener: logo sits hard left, immediately followed by the image tile and phone as a product group, then the headline and a full-height CTA close the strip, so it reads brand to product to message to action.
